input.explanation:
Fault: average_spend_per_item_this_month divides this month's total by len(bought) without checking that any purchase falls in the current month. Any account viewing the account page with zero purchases this month (which the flag made reachable) hits `x // 0` and the request fails with ZeroDivisionError. Whatever flag or deploy made that code path reachable, the defect is the unguarded division.

Fix: treat "no purchases this month" as an average of 0 cents and return early, so the function is total on all accounts. Also made Account actually store total_cents and total_this_month_cents — the constructor accepted them and dropped them, so any caller reading account.total_this_month_cents would have raised AttributeError; storing them lets the function (and the tests) work on a real Account.

Tests: added a case for the shopper with no purchases this month (the failing case, now asserted to return 0), plus the pre-existing "did buy" case filled in with a real assertion, and a case where purchases exist but none are in the current month.
input.summary: Return 0 instead of raising ZeroDivisionError when an account has no purchases this month
